## Service area

Sacramento, Folsom, Roseville, El Dorado Hills, and nearby.

## Services

- Missed-call text-back: a text goes back when a call is missed. $99 a month after a free 30-day pilot. No setup fee. Month to month. Founding client price.
- Website: a custom site for one local business, fast on a phone, built so the next step is a call or a lead. $1,500 one time, plus $49 a month for hosting and small edits. Paid 50% up front and 50% at launch. The client keeps the site.
- Google and AI search: Your Google listing, the towns you serve, pages Google and ChatGPT can read, and a ChatGPT business profile claimed and kept up to date where ChatGPT supports your type of business. $199 a month.
- DANZUS Growth: missed-call text-back, Google and AI search, and hosting. $299 a month. With a 6-month commitment, the website is $750. If you cancel before month 6, the website is $1,500 and we bill the other $750.
- Lead to Booked Job: a new inquiry becomes a time on the calendar.
- Estimate to payment: an estimate becomes money in the account.
- Job Closeout: a finished job leaves a review and a referral.
- Back Office: the inbox, the bills, and the week land in one place.
- Customer Service: the customer gets an answer, a status, or a person.

The assistant uses the calendar, QuickBooks, your customer list, and the texting the shop already has. A person signs off on anything risky before it reaches a customer.

## Prices

- Missed-call text-back: $99 a month after a free 30-day pilot. No setup fee. Month to month. Founding client price.
- Website: $1,500 one time, plus $49 a month for hosting and small edits. Paid 50% up front and 50% at launch. The client keeps the site.
- Google and AI search: $199 a month.
- DANZUS Growth: $299 a month for missed-call text-back, Google and AI search, and hosting. With a 6-month commitment, the website is $750. If you cancel before month 6, the website is $1,500 and we bill the other $750.

Those monthly charges renew each month at the same price until the customer cancels. Cancel online at https://danzus.co/cancel, email dan@danzus.co, or call (916) 404-6129. The $1,500 website build does not renew. If you stay on DANZUS Growth for 6 months, the website costs $750 instead of $1,500. You pay it once. If you cancel before month 6, the website is $1,500 and we bill the other $750.
